TWO api.bseindia.com PATHS ARE REFUSED AT BSE'S EDGE even with the honest headers from scripts/bse_headers.py: StockReachGraph and getScripHeaderData both returned the Akamai 'Access Denied' body (Reference #18.f0263e17.1791815977 and .1791815978) while ComHeadernew, AnnSubCategoryGetData, Corp_detailedResult_Transpose_ng, the scrip master and the bhavcopies all answered 200 on the same connection in the same minutes. Reported as measured: this is BSE's edge refusing those two paths, NOT a sandbox allowlist (a sandbox block carries x-deny-reason: host_not_allowed) and NOT a header problem. ComHeadernew also returned an EMPTY BODY, not an error, on rapid repeat calls - four in a row at ~1 s spacing all came back empty and all four succeeded at 4 s spacing. Any script looping over company headers needs 4 s between calls and must treat an empty body as a retryable rate-limit, not as 'no data'.
